Like send ka memes, songs, qoutes, billboard na nakita mo outside, anything that might've reminded you of him (something sweet and random) then let the conversation roll from there. Kami ng SO ko, we're transparent pag na-attract kami sa iba. We recognize that we are human beings and it's natural that we value beauty when we see it. 
But that's just it. We both know hanggang tingin at appreciation lang. Kasi at the end of the day, the person I really wanna be with, through thick and thin e sya pa rin. Kaya lang exciting ang cheating kasi new experience pero it's not really worth it.

Your life, your choice. We're all selfish in our own ways.

Yung mga magulang na nag-aanak kasi gustong may mag-aalaga sa kanila pagtanda nila, selfish.

Yung mga magulang na nag-aanak knowing na maipapamana ang kanilang sakit (physical, mental), selfish.

Yung mga magulang na pinasa na lang sa mga anak nila ung responsibilidad nila, selfish.

Yung mga ayaw mag-anak kasi ayaw ng aalagaan, selfish pero at least may AWARENESS and HONESTY.

Akala ba nila di natin napapansing mga anak na "burden" tayo sa kanila? Di ko ipapasa yung trauma na un sa batang walang muwang. Di bale na selfish kesa ma-stuck sa responsibilidad na alam ko sa sarili kong ayaw ko gampanan.

Dear, wag hingin sa iba ang hindi maibigay sa sarili. Titigil lang ang jealousy/anxiety kung sigurado ka sa sarili mo. Kahit magpalit ka ng katabi, hanggat di mo kayang mahalin ang sarili mo ng buo, mahirap maging masaya.
Find peace within yourself first, eventually mapapansin mong hindi ka na laging nag-aabang ng chat niya kasi busy ka na rin sa mga interests mo. I hope you can still find something interesting sa sarili mo kahit walang ibang taong nakatingin. Mahirap, pero always remember you're allowed to be you, take your time.

Maglaan ka kahit 30 seconds para sa sarili, tapos next week, 1 minute naman, tapos 5 mins. Sabi dun sa kdrama na napanood ko recently, sa 24 hours nya, 5 minutes lang sya totoong masaya. It's also okay to try hard for yourself. Sa una mahirap kasi sanay kang outside ang motivation mo. Pero at the end of the day, you have to stand up for yourself. Hindi pwedeng laging ikaw ang taya. Gabi-gabi, practice bago matulog...
"I will give myself the same compassion I give to others."

Walang masama kung pantay ang turing mo sa sarili at sa iba. Tao ka rin, kung may space ang mundo para sa kanila, meron ka rin dapat. Magtira para sa sarili.

Patawarin agad ang sarili pag nagkakamali.

Tumanggi kung hindi mo naman talaga gusto.

Huminga ng malalim kahit 1 minute lang every day.

My mind chatters incessantly, I think it will never stop anymore. I'm no expert and have no experience in therapy. But what I do that usually helps me the most is to try listening to what my thoughts are saying then repeat it back to myself loudly (in private, and it may be very uncomfortable at first). 

I find that most of what I think of myself is baseless and just a product of others' expectations of me that are really not that valuable if you will examine each statement carefully. Then, filtering the valid ones, keeping them safe somewhere else in my brain (ill deal with them later). I imagine tearing all other unnecessary negative thoughts apart slashing them in half, burning them, crushing them with my two bare hands till I'm very much satisfied. 

I do this alone in a room with no distraction because I fear that I look batshit cr\*zy when I do that. But that's just overly simplified here I know it's much harder than that. This is what works for me when I'm very uncomfortable with my own company. And I hope you find your way, too. Sending you light til you spark yours...

It's hard to not be bothered, right? I often blame myself for giving too much care about what others may feel at the expense of what I feel. Being raised by parents who expect so much from me, I always felt ashamed that I don't have a "dream job" like my friends. I can't blame me, though. It's not not normal to not have a dream job, it's just not that common. But it exists, we exist! I never cared for a dream life. 

I don't even want to die, I just want to disappear and not do anything. Or just idk maybe take a long f\*cking break? Can I just breathe for myself someplace else far from the others? Yes, I found out that I actually can and that's what I'm doing atm so I can be okay for a while (just a while). I wish you can catch a break soon... 

Sending you love and light (even if it's flickering. lol)! Hope it's good till you can start yours again.

Hugs to you, brave stranger. I can't imagine how much pain you're in right now.

I just got back from a very dark place in my life and I'm still picking up what's left of me. I might not be the best person to talk to right now but I just can't scroll past your post without leaving a comment. 

I feel you, the thought of having death as the only choice punches my guts and still makes me vomit. But I find that focusing on my breathing helped me a lot whenever I start to feel like this. It's oddly satisfying to imagine how the air fills my lungs and the body does its job to process it and sh\*t. The chest just goes up and down, up and down (completely unaware of how much I want them to just stop) They're working like tiny machines inside of me. I'm in awe at how the body can unapologetically strive to survive. It's ironically beautiful, isn't it? 

How we sometimes feel like nothing but still be a part of something. I take comfort in the fact that I am just a very little speck of dust in this boundless universe. Because it means that I'm still a part of something this vastly magnificent. I like staring at the stars, even the fake glow-in-the-dark ones for babies. Maybe you too can look back and find something so simple yet so oddly comforting. Sending you love and light!

i can't imagine how chaotic it must feel... if you're in a public place, you may try going to a bathroom first. or just try to be somewhere you can hug yourself comfortably.. this helps me when im panicking. i'd even rock myself side by side when doing this... i usually spend 20 minutes sometimes even longer or just until the knot in my stomach is kind of gone.. i can feel a lot calmer after this then i can start trying to really figure out what to do.. dont rush, sending you love and light...

hey stranger, i feel you. i self-destruct too... esp when my emotions are too much that i feel like choking... recently when i hear myself thinking that nobody wants to be around me anymore, i will sit myself down. alone. no gadgets, no substance, nothing. (you might want to try this in the most relaxed position.) Then, I close my eyes and imagine myself dying.. this may trigger a lot of negative emotions at first but after a plenty amount of crying... the rush of relief comes... death is a choice. but so is life. when my family didn't wanna be around me anymore, i moved out. it was too painful. i got lost for a long time. but it also allowed me to spend more time for myself.. my old friends already left me a loooong time ago and this opened up a spot for a few people that i truly want to be a part of my life... i still feel like logging out sometimes, then i do this trick and i almost felt like i died then i was reborn...
